brief: Checks whether an array contains a value
description: Checks whether an array contains searchElement, as ECMAScript includes does: the same as index_of(array, searchElement, fromIndex) >= 0. Values are compared by value (equal arrays and objects match) and NaN is found.

parameters.brief: Index in the array to start
parameters.description: Index to start the search at. Negative counts from the end. At or past the end, nothing is found. Default 0.
parameters.name: fromIndex

returns.brief: Indicates if the element is found
returns.description: Indicates if the element is found in array.
